prompt: Sort the list `out` by weight and then alphabetically using a Comparator chain. Start with Comparator.comparingInt and give it a lambda with an explicitly typed parameter (String s) that returns w.get(s), then chain thenComparing(Comparator.naturalOrder()). The typed parameter is required so Java can infer the types in the chain.
why: With chained comparators the compiler cannot infer the lambda parameter type, so annotate it: (String s).
